about: What looking at CubiCasa5K plans has settled, for scripts/cubicasaBenchmark.mjs. `exclude`: plans whose answer key cannot be trusted in a way no rule in lib/cubicasa.mjs catches, each with its reason; the benchmark skips them. `watch`: plans that show one failure, found by looking, so a fix can be tried on them in seconds (--watch NAME) before the dev split checks it broke nothing else. Train and val plans only: test stays unseen.

exclude.high_quality/11847: Several units on one sheet: the answer key covers one of them and nothing in the image says which.

light-walls.about: Walls drawn in a grey, green, tan or blue tone rather than black: the tracer followed the fixtures and line work and missed the rooms, or the whole plan. Six were walls the fill-aware split set aside, now given back. 13695 and 9417 lose one room each behind a run of windows drawn in thin light lines: on a diagonal wall in 13695; in 9417 a 330 px window drawn as three light strips, which the glazing rescue does not read as one band.

page-border.about: A frame around the page traced as the building.

double-line-walls.about: An exterior wall drawn as two lines, traced along the inner one, so a band of wall is missing all round.

drawings-merged.about: Two floors or units drawn side by side, closed into one outline across the gap between them. The drawings cut separates 14678. Still merged: 9192, whose right-hand drawing closes a room only with a weld reaching across the gap, so the cut would lose it; 3692 and 13013, where an entrance or a stair drawn in the gap leaves too narrow a clear band for the gap the weld closed; 5912, whose drawings overlap along both axes, so no straight band separates them.

stuck-to-outline.about: Text, a watermark or a door swing touching the exterior wall, taken into the outline.

non-gla-kept.about: A labelled balcony, porch or terrace left in the outline after the glazing fix: partly carved, drawn with a tiled floor, or named in handwriting. A balcony whose door onto the room sits at a corner leaks into the room too (12511, 10403): the carve's barrier closes a door gap only where wall continues on both sides of it.

boarded-decks.about: Decks, terraces and balconies drawn in boards or tiles, which the carve's barrier reads as wall: the label lands on the boards or in a strip between two. The boards carve takes 11194, 11195, 4054 and 6296; 3721's hatching is fused into solid ink, and 107's paving grid is spaced wider than a board.
